subject: [PATCH v6 05/12] mm, swap: enable THP swapin for vswap entries

2026-10-21.patch_summary: This patch enables transparent huge page (THP) swapin for vswap entries, allowing large anonymous folios to be swapped in as a unit when their vswap entries share contiguous physical swap slots on a synchronous IO device. This improves performance by reducing the number of faults and retries required during the swap process. The patch checks the backing type of vswap entries and rejects batches with non-THP-amenable backings, such as uniformly ZSWAP or mixed-backing. If the backing is THP-amenable, the folio is swapped in at its original order; otherwise, the fault retries at a smaller order.
